query: checkout is failing at the gateway but customers say their orders went through, what is happening
discriminator: The caller fails and the callee succeeds: the gateway gives up while orders records the order as paid and payments records the authorisation, so the failure is the caller's deadline rather than anything downstream.

evidence.summary: recent errors: gateway only, all 'System.Threading.Tasks.TaskCanceledException: The operation was canceled' on POST /api/checkout; orders, payments and notifications logged no errors in the same window

one failed checkout: gateway POST /api/checkout 163ms status 500, its outgoing client span cancelled at 50ms, orders POST /orders 499, and below that payments POST /payments/authorize 200 and notifications POST /notifications 201
orders logs for the same window: 'Order 79e67b32 paid, total 39.8 TRY' repeated for every checkout the gateway reported as failed
error rate in the last 30 minutes: gateway 100% on POST /api/checkout; orders 0%, payments 0%, notifications 0%
response time in the last 30 minutes (ms): the gateway's failures land at about 50ms, well below the ~80ms a successful checkout took the day before
architecture gateway: the gateway owns no data and fans out to the other services; its downstream client is configured with a single timeout shared across those calls
